title: CBIC Implements Ekal Anubandh Electronic Bond Facility from August 24, 2026
content:
# CBIC Implements Ekal Anubandh Electronic Bond Facility from August 24, 2026

Ek important update hai. Government ne Single Unified Multi-Purpose Electronic Bond (SEB) facility implement karne ka announce kiya hai, jise 'Ekal Anubandh' project ke तहत introduce kiya gaya hai. This is a significant step towards digitizing customs processes.

*   **What is Ekal Anubandh?**
    The Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) has introduced the "Ekal Anubandh" initiative, which essentially means a Single Unified Multi-Purpose Electronic Bond (SEB). Under this, importers and exporters can submit one all-India multipurpose electronic bond via the ICEGATE portal, replacing the need for separate, transaction-wise bonds at different ports.

*   **Why this change?**
    This move aims to streamline customs procedures, enhance efficiency, and reduce the administrative burden on businesses. It promises to save time and costs by providing an end-to-end digital solution for bond management and execution. The process includes electronic stamp-duty payment and execution through NeSL, along with online linking and verification of e-Bank Guarantees.

*   **Key Implementation Date:**
    While the e-Bond and e-Bank Guarantee facility became operational with immediate effect upon its introduction, manual Bonds and Bank Guarantees (BGs) ki acceptance **August 24, 2026, se band ho jayegi**, except for rare cases with prior approval.

*   **Official Document Reference:**
    This initiative was introduced vide **Circular No. 04/2025-Customs dated 17th February, 2025**.
